name: bestbus
description: Live intercity bus departures in Thailand with a booking link for each bus.

interface.longDescription: Find intercity buses in Thailand and book a seat. BestBus shows the live departures for a route and date: departure time, bus company, boarding terminal and fare in Thai baht, across 15,000+ routes and 150+ bus companies, including Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Phuket, Krabi, Pattaya, Hua Hin and the islands. Every departure comes with a Book link that opens that exact bus on bestbus.me, where you pick your seats, enter passenger details and pay by Thai QR, card or bank app; the e-ticket arrives by email. You can also ask for the usual daily timetable of a route (first and last bus, fares, journey time, companies, boarding points) or where buses go from a town. BestBus does not take bookings or payments inside ChatGPT and needs no account or personal data.
defaultPrompt: Bus from Bangkok to Phuket this Friday
What time is the first bus from Bangkok to Chiang Mai?
Where can I go by bus from Krabi?

positive.prompt: Find me a bus from Bangkok to Phuket next Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: List the departures on sale for that date with time, bus company, boarding terminal and fare in THB, each with a Book link to bestbus.me.

positive.prompt: We are 3 people, bus from Bangkok to Pattaya tomorrow morning.
positive.expected_behavior: List tomorrow's departures for 3 passengers; the Book links carry pax=3.

positive.prompt: How long is the bus from Bangkok to Krabi and when does the last bus leave?
positive.expected_behavior: Give departures a day, first and last bus, fastest journey time, fare range and boarding points, with a link to the route page.

positive.prompt: Where can I go by bus from Krabi?
positive.expected_behavior: List destinations from Krabi, busiest first, with buses a day and the lowest fare.

positive.prompt: Is there a bus from Phuket to Chiang Rai on 20 December?
positive.expected_behavior: Say there is no direct BestBus bus on this route and offer the destinations that are served from Phuket, without inventing departures.

negative.description: Payment inside the chat is not supported
negative.prompt: Pay for my bus ticket with my credit card here in the chat.

negative.description: Cancelling or changing a booking is not supported
negative.prompt: Cancel my BestBus booking and refund me.

negative.description: Not a bus trip in Thailand
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to Paris.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell or take payment inside ChatGPT. It shows bus departures; the traveller books and pays on bestbus.me.

publication.release_notes: First release: live bus departures in Thailand with a booking link per bus, route timetables, and destinations from a town.
